# slop — a linter and code-structure query tool

> Checks code against published structural measures (McCabe, Campbell, Nejmeh, Chidamber and Kemerer, Hitz and Montazeri, Martin) and answers questions about it: where a name is defined, what a scope holds, how a class is shaped, how its vocabulary compares with a canonical one.

`slop` is the CLI of the `agent-slop-lint` package.

- [README](https://github.com/JordanGunn/agent-slop-lint/blob/main/README.md): install, commands, rules and default limits, languages.
- [Configuration reference](https://github.com/JordanGunn/agent-slop-lint/blob/main/docs/CONFIG.md): `exclude`, per-rule `enabled` and options, inline `slop: ignore[rule]`.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/JordanGunn/agent-slop-lint/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
